prompts.01-paper-composed.png:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity Android Hush home redesign, more alive and intentional while remaining minimal.
Primary request: a warm editorial home with character, NOT a bare search field floating in an empty page. Single flat portrait 9:20 mobile screenshot, precise shippable native UI, no phone frame, no external labels. Existing warm paper #F6F3EB, pine #24483D, sage #DCECE1, Manrope-like sans-serif. Clear 20dp gutters and accessible controls.
Top compact header lowercase rounded h mark and "Hush" left, incognito mask and overflow right, status bar 9:41.
Create a composed upper home area: at 24dp below header, small sage breathing ring motif with three fine concentric incomplete arcs, about 64dp, aligned left beside editorial title verbatim "YouTube, with
room to pause." in handsome dark-pine 30sp medium type, not massive. The ring echoes the existing breathing tool, adds quiet visual identity. Flat vector-like lines, no glow, no large illustrations. Give this composition a softly tinted pale-sage rounded background panel about 150dp high with generous padding.
Directly below a 52dp subtle rounded search field "Search YouTube", magnifier left, pine ink on light tonal surface, no microphone. Below a small heading "Recent searches" and two understated chips with clock icons "lofi girl" and "jazz".
Below, compact section "Your library" with three small equal tactile shortcut tiles: clock icon "History", bookmark "Saved", download "Downloads". Existing app destinations only, no fake counts. Each tile about 72dp high, low contrast warm-stone surface, 16dp corner radius.
Create balanced vertical rhythm so upper content fills about 55 percent of screen; leave generous but not enormous rest area.
Playing state: place small text "Now playing" and one line "lofi hip hop radio" in left part of lower listening region, and a FLOATING video window lower right, approx 184x104dp, 16:9, generic illustrated warm desk and city window scene, rounded corners and subtle shadow. Controls inside frame: tiny expand top-left, close top-right, pause center. Window remains visually detached from page, 24dp clear gap ABOVE navigation, never touching or covering bottom buttons. No full-width player strip, no metadata card attached to window. Text has restrained hierarchy.
Persistent bottom rounded tonal navigation tray with EXACT three equal items in order "Search", "Games", "Breathe", magnifier/gamepad/lowercase h icons; Search selected sage capsule, all 12sp labels visible. Android gesture line beneath safe gap.
Constraints: no recommendation feed, no video lists, no giant meditation card or game cards, no extra tabs, no statistics, streaks, badges or fabricated features. Use ONLY supplied labels. This is a home with composed identity, useful personal shortcuts, and floating playback rather than empty filler. Crisp refined typography and realistic compact sizes. Flat colors, no gradients, no glass, no excessive shadow.

Existing brand colors: deep pine #111B17, pine surfaces #1C2922, sage #C4D8CB, paper #EDF3EC, secondary #B3C3B6. Flat colors, native Manrope-like sans serif, subtle fine strokes, 20dp gutters. Android status bar 9:41.

Below header at 32dp, a small sage incomplete breathing circle motif, followed by the existing tagline, exact copy "YouTube, with
room to pause." in beautiful 32sp medium weight left-aligned. This is ON THE PAGE SURFACE, no enclosing hero card, no huge artwork. Plenty of rhythm but not giant blank desert.
Below 28dp, one modest 52dp-high dark tonal search field "Search YouTube", magnifier, 16sp text. Under it two tiny optional recent search chips "lofi girl" and "jazz" with history icons, no extra heading.
Below 24dp, single compact understated library toolbar with three equal 48dp-high text-and-icon buttons "History", "Saved", "Downloads", small 18dp outline icons. No library tiles, no section box, no subtitles, no counts.
Lower half has an active listening composition: left aligned tiny label "Now playing", title "lofi hip hop radio" in 21sp paper, a fine SHORT sage sound-wave motif beside label, illustrative of playback, not interactive. Float a true 16:9 video window about 208x117dp at lower right, generic warm lamp-lit desk scene with cat and city at dusk, rounded corners. It is a draggable in-app PiP-style VIDEO, no title or footer attached to its frame. Controls only inside frame: expand top-left, close top-right, pause center. Keep generous 28dp clear gap ABOVE bottom nav, never overlap any button. Use the warm video imagery as the only rich colorful element, no fullwidth player strip or second media surface.
Bottom navigation: slim rounded dark tonal tray with exactly three equal destinations in order "Search", "Games", "Breathe". Icons magnifier, gamepad, lowercase h. Search selected small sage-toned capsule behind icon, visible 12sp labels. Bottom gesture safe area.
Constraints: no recommendations feed, no hero meditation card, no game cards, no extra nav items, no fabricated stats or badges, no slogans beyond supplied exact tagline, no giant logo, no glowing UI, no gradients. All controls readable. More life than an empty search page, less visual clutter than a card dashboard. Distinct emphasis: editorial title unboxed, useful library text links, contextual listening, floating video, clean bottom navigation.
